flaws.title: Current EU Policy Flaws (Why Simple Tariffs Fail)

points.name: Tariff Circumvention via CKD Assembly
points.detail: Chinese OEMs bypass 21%–35% countervailing duties by establishing CKD/SKD assembly plants in Hungary, Spain, and Turkey, qualifying vehicles as EU-origin while keeping software, chips, and battery supply chains in China.

points.name: Reactive FDI Screening & Derivative Blindspots
points.detail: Current German AWV (10%) and EU FDI screening triggers fail completely against synthetic equity derivatives (Zero-cost collars, Total Return Swaps) and multi-broker warehousing under 3% disclosure limits.

points.name: Zero Data & Telemetry Border Regulation
points.detail: Connected vehicles embedded with Chinese sensor stacks and telemetry inverters operate on European roads without mandatory sovereign source-code or intelligence-jurisdiction auditing.

reforms.title: 1. European IRA / Enhanced CRMA Production Incentives
points: Condition all EU EV purchase subsidies and municipal tax credits on a minimum 60% European/Allied component and mineral content (Non-FEOC compliance).
Provide direct CAPEX matching grants for cathode/anode gigafactories partnering exclusively with NATO-aligned Tier-1 battery specialists (Korean Big 3, European champions).
Establish capped industrial electricity tariffs for automotive-grade semiconductor foundries and mineral refining facilities located within the EU.

reforms.title: 2. Automotive Cyber & Data Border Tax
points: Mandatory sovereign cybersecurity certification for all connected vehicle software stacks, LiDAR/camera telemetry, and battery management systems.
Strict statutory ban on vehicles transmitting real-time sensor or telemetry data to entities legally bound by foreign intelligence cooperation laws (e.g. PRC Intelligence Law Art. 7).
Impose a punitive 'Data Border Levy' on foreign connected vehicle platforms that refuse third-party source-code escrow auditing.

reforms.title: 3. Mandatory Tech Reciprocity & Golden Shares
points: Enact statutory reciprocity: Prohibit foreign state-backed entities from acquiring or holding >10% in critical European tech/mobility assets unless identical reciprocal investment rights exist in the foreign jurisdiction.
Close WpHG / EU Transparency Directive loopholes by mandating immediate, real-time disclosure of all synthetic equity derivatives (swaps, collars) at a 3% threshold.
Legislative Golden Shares granting European national governments statutory veto power over hostile takeovers and forced technology transfers in core mobility/AI infrastructure.
